citations.assessment: Rabbi Zakkai recites the beam and entrance plank teaching. Yochanan expressly sends him to recite outside.

Zakkai recites the convert interpretation before Rabbi Yochanan at the start of the side. Yochanan objects there. Later, the same formula about reciting outside follows Rav Shmuel bar Yehudah’s alternate account of what was recited.
Zakkai teaches liability for only one offering for multiple services. Yochanan directs him to recite outside.
Both passages attest the named interlocutors. Bava Batra reads the cave of Rav Zakkai’s house; Eruvin reads its press. Preserve Heilprin’s press wording and report the difference.

The Yerushalmi treats three acts of worship differently from the checked Bavli. Heilprin reads Yochanan’s remark in the first person (עברתי). The checked Yerushalmi has the second-person עברת בידך and continues with a statement about breaking. Keep the received Heilprin wording in English and give the variant separately.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

holds.reason: Bava Batra gives the cave and Eruvin the press. Which received Bava Batra witness Heilprin used remains uncollated.
The Jerusalem Talmud has a second-person form where Heilprin gives a first-person form, retained in translation. Printed variants remain open.
